annotations.title: Find a place or identifier on the map

description: Use to locate an identifier or a place on the map: a tenement ("E 53/1209"), a WAMEX report ("A12345"), a drillhole id, a map sheet, a place name, or coordinates in decimal degrees ("-30.75, 121.47"), degrees-minutes-seconds ("30°45'S 121°28'12\"E") or MGA ("MGA51 352000 6600000"). Returns each match's kind, label, detail, lon/lat and bbox, with a map link that opens the point's summary card. Companies and projects are found with search_tenement_holders.

q.description: An identifier, place name or coordinates.

name: find_on_map
